personality_one_liner: A highly functional, data-dense, and highly readable sports tracking and administration tool.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around structural containers, tight spacing inside data rows. Thumb zone action buttons at bottom.

do's: Use on sticky headers above scrolling lists
Use on the floating chat button (FAB) background
dont's: Do not use on data table rows or standard list items
Do not use on numpad keys

screens.name: Competitions List (Home)
screens.purpose: Public view of upcoming, live, and past competitions with filtering.

states.empty: Empty clipboard icon with 'Nessuna gara trovata'

screens.layout: Sticky segmented control for filters (Live, Today, Past). Scrollable list of match cards. Each card uses high data density: clear title, date, status chip (sky/violet/red/slate), and a prominent red 'Live' banner if active. Thumb zone CTA for Login/Admin.

screens.name: Live Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Real-time ranking display split by categories.
screens.layout: Top sticky segmented control (Sectors / Absolute / Clubs / Teams). Expandable row pattern for complex competitor data to preserve viewport space. Highlight first place in emerald, pending in amber.

screens.name: Judge Console
screens.purpose: Command center for the judge to manage the competition.
screens.layout: Fixed timer controls (Start/Pause/Stop) at the top. Scrollable list of entries. Tapping an entry opens a bottom sheet with a Custom Numpad (large touch targets, no standard QWERTY) for weigh-in. Validation buttons (Approve in emerald/Reject in red) sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Inspector Screen
screens.layout: List of assigned pegs/sectors. Tapping a peg opens the Custom Numpad sheet for fast measurement entry. Floating action button for Chat.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the specific color semantics defined: #0F3D56 for primary actions/brand, #E63946 for the Live accent, Emerald for success/1st place, Amber for pending, Yellow for technical sectors.
Data Density: Ensure lists and tables use space efficiently. Implement expandable list items for the leaderboard to show granular details without cluttering the main view.

Input & Validation: The Judge and Inspector screens MUST use a custom-built numerical pad component inside a bottom sheet for weigh-in and measurement. DO NOT trigger the native QWERTY keyboard for numeric inputs to avoid validation errors and improve speed.
Navigation: Keep primary CTAs (Submit, Validate) sticky at the bottom above the home indicator, especially inside the numpad bottom sheet.
Ensure all data text is highly readable. Use monospaced fonts (System-Mono equivalent) for numerical scores, weights, and timers if possible.
Apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern if placing any text over the `hero_fishing` image.
